facts.statement: Asian Paints Limited presents its Integrated Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 covering standalone and consolidated operations.
facts.quote: The Integrated Annual Report of Asian Paints Limited presents a comprehensive overview  of our financial, operational and sustainability performance for the year.

facts.statement: Standalone and Consolidated Financial Statements have been audited by Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP.
facts.quote: Standalone and Consolidated  Financial Statements have been audited by  Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP ('DHS'), Chartered Accountants, Statutory Auditors.

facts.statement: The Board of Asian Paints approved the Integrated Annual Report on 29th May 2026.
facts.quote: The Board of Asian Paints approved this Integrated Annual Report on  29th May 2026.

facts.statement: The company engages with over 137,000 business influencers.
Asian Paints paid taxes amounting to Rs 5,067.0 Crores.
